description: Stamped badge: a scalloped seal slams in and settles, a ring of text turns around it, a short word or icon sits in the middle; exits with a spin. Offers, 'new', 'limited', stickers on product shots. Transparent.

params.center: Short centre text (1-2 words, | for a line break) or an icon
params.ring: Text around the ring (repeats to fill), e.g. 'NEW FLAVOUR • LIMITED •'
params.position: center | top-left | top | top-right | left | right | bottom-left | bottom | bottom-right (default top-right)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output
